run_throw_on_failure_test: run the googletest throw-on-failure test suite with gtest_test_utils.Main to verify assertion failure exit codes
test_throw_on_failure_env_var: test the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable by setting it to 0 or 1 and verifying exit behavior
test_throw_on_failure_flag: test the --gtest_throw_on_failure CLI flag by passing 0 or 1 and verifying assertion failure exit codes
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_throw_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable in all combinations
set_env_var_utility: use SetEnvVar to set or unset an environment variable by passing the variable name and value or None
